title: Is ElevenLabs Dubbing Right for Your Localization Workflow?
markdown:
ElevenLabs Dubbing is worth considering when you need to adapt existing audio or video for audiences in other languages and want an automated workflow. Its current Dubbing v2 Alpha supports dubbing across 90+ languages, works with audio and video, and can handle up to 32 unique speakers in a file. ElevenLabs says it preserves speakers’ tone, pace, and style while retaining original background audio. [Official capability documentation](https://elevenlabs.io/docs/overview/capabilities/dubbing)

The practical fit is strongest for teams that can accept automatic output. In the standard v2 flow, you upload a file or paste a supported video URL, choose target languages, adjust speaker similarity if needed, review the displayed cost, and submit the dub. V2 dubs made through the website cannot be edited after creation. If detailed transcript editing, speaker reassignment, or clip regeneration is essential, those controls belong to the legacy v1/Dubbing Studio route, which ElevenLabs describes as being in maintenance mode. [Dubbing product guide](https://elevenlabs.io/docs/eleven-creative/products/dubbing)

Check the trade-offs before choosing. Dubbing v2 is in alpha, so ElevenLabs notes that occasional rough edges may occur. It does not provide real-time or live dubbing, and lip sync is not included as part of Dubbing. Free-plan dubs are automatically watermarked; paid-plan dubs are not. [Capabilities and limitations](https://elevenlabs.io/docs/overview/capabilities/dubbing) [Dubbing FAQ](https://elevenlabs.io/docs/eleven-creative/products/dubbing)

For budget planning, ElevenLabs lists Dubbing credit costs by workflow: 2,000 credits per minute for automatic dubbing with watermark, 3,000 without watermark, 5,000 for Dubbing Studio with watermark, and 10,000 without watermark. Credits are shared across products, so dubbing use reduces the same monthly pool used by other ElevenLabs products. The pricing page lists plans from Free through paid tiers; taxes, levies, and duties are excluded from listed prices. [Official pricing](https://elevenlabs.io/pricing)

Choose it if automated multilingual versions and preservation of the source performance are your main priorities. Consider the legacy workflow only when its editing controls outweigh its maintenance-mode status, and confirm the current cost shown before you generate.
